_comment: Accepted, understood deviations. The build fails on anything not listed here (or bigger than listed).

yoga-downward-dog._why: the toes swing round as the foot pivots from top-down to sole-down

yoga-bound-angle._why: the camera turns to the front while the knees fall open; the blend of the two poses sits the pelvis up a little mid-move. To rebuild (v2 follow-up: problem poses)

yoga-side-plank._why: rolling from plank to side plank turns the body round its long axis, which a blend of lean angles only approximates: the support hand lifts a little mid-move. To rebuild (v2 follow-up: problem poses)
